Per the Warranty Policy, Meridian gives a 2-year labor warranty on full system installations, and Comfort Club members at the time of installation get a 5-year labor warranty, so a January install is still within the 2-year period.

Manufacturer warranties cover the part only, and labor to replace a warranted part is billable only after the Meridian labor warranty expires.
On the diagnostic fee, the Warranty Policy says that if the failure is covered there is no fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies.
